why: An open key (a number, a string, a template) on a plain record of data fields is one uninterpreted lookup of the record value and the key, the same function on both sides. numberName reads the next key (unproved, WITNESS at n = 0: "zero" against "one"); isText binds the receiver and the key to names and reads twice, the same lookup of the same values (proved); hasMedia is untouched (proved).
